programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:聖靈降臨,所為何事? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師-末了的話 專題的研究
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《 專題的研究》。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 今日説法
programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持「點滴記錄中國法治進程」的理念,以「重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓」為宗旨,採用「以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評」的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽「中國人的法制午餐」。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

高朋滿座#234粵
programme.desc: 朋與溢將事實告知眾人，悅表現出堅強的一面，支撐起大局。晚上朋卻發現悅只是在強裝鎮定，眾人開解將失業的溢，溢卻表示借此闖一番事業。朋終於接受手術，眾人紛紛到醫院陪伴，慶更在病床前告訴朋一個秘密。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 龍嘯青不悅白愁飛當上副樓主，狄飛驚從中挑撥；龍嘯青設局想拿下狄飛驚，卻被李念堂背叛，反被狄飛驚抓回六分半堂；小石來到關龍嘯青的牢獄，不料遇上朱小腰，救出龍嘯青後，朱小腰表明自己是金風細雨樓的弓箭手…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽一連兩集煮出十道與蝦相關的菜式。兩母子走到「蝦之百貨」，選購生猛基圍蝦、海中蝦及赤米蝦入饌。蝦仁拍成蝦膠，加雪耳、蛋白後搓成丸子，再放上杞子，蒸出滿有詩意的「白雪明珠」。買蝦通常越大越好，為何「龍井蝦仁」的蝦仁卻越小越好？肥媽教路，輕易煮出「花雕醉蝦」、「黃金蝦」兩道大熱菜式，黃金蝦加了甚麼令食者減輕因蛋黃而生的罪疚感？將赤米蝦混入牛油果、番茄之中，「牛油果甜蝦莎莎」就此誕生。

programme.title: 航向未來粵
programme.desc: 運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 多數更年期女士均會經歷潮熱，如嚴重還會影響日常生活，持續潮熱亦可增加患上心血管疾病的風險。治療方面，現時採用的非荷爾蒙藥物如何做到改善這症狀？留意婦產科醫生詳細解說。膽管炎有很多種類，成因、治療方法都不同。外科醫生提到，在香港最常見的病因是由膽石引起，膽石又是怎樣形成？醫生提醒患者不應因膽石體積小而忽略，而均衡飲食與適當運動均有助預防膽石及膽管炎。「睇餸食飯」，譚詠儀師傅示範「港味花螺」。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 第四回合，拍檔們要透過頭盤、主菜、甜品去講一個故事。黎諾懿、沈依紅把冰室美食「法式化」，黎總style的羅宋湯、炒牛河與西多士，令人期待！龔嘉欣、李家鋌則思考將飲宴佳餚呈現。嘉欣細心洗刷主打食材鮑魚，並得評判提醒訣要；加入芭樂、乳酪的楊枝甘露，幻化少女粉紅色彩。未評分，兩隊先自行檢討，有人帶漏材料，有人感慨甜品狀態不如理想！雖有不足，眾評判的評語讚賞不停，最終哪對拍檔取勝，率先出線？

programme.title: 大帥哥#10粵PG
programme.desc: 艾妞、天嬌送涼茶為軍人打氣，士氣立即飆升！細龜、佘南談判合作對付狄奇，可惜談不攏，反被狄奇作弄及恐嚇二人不可瓜分祿豐鎮。有軍人意外偷窺沅婉，馬炭反應過於激烈，沅婉從狄奇口中知道馬炭失控背後經歷。沅婉稱可為馬炭的指套保用一輩子，馬炭情不自禁擁抱她。馬炭悄悄送上一瓶狗尾草，沅婉誤以為是狄奇所送，甜在心頭，馬炭臉色一沉，狄奇則似有所悟。軍人訓練未如理想，軍費卻所剩無幾，狄奇經落蘆提醒後要求鎮中富商交稅。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子想知道自己會說什麼夢話，於是聽從爺爺建議，嘗試用錄音機錄下自己的夢話。小丸子化身日本童話《漏雨老宅》中的小狼女，與一眾動物齊心協力調查濱治爺爺所說的最可怕事物是什麼東西。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 位於沙頭角的谷埔村是一條擁有逾三百年歷史的鄉村，至今仍保留着深厚的客家文化。而受獨特地理位置與殖民歷史影響，在村內溝通竟可能要用上英語、西班牙話等外語。「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓還介紹了客家飲食冷知識，例如現時的甜點糯米糍，就被指是源自傳統客家茶粿。谷埔村內保存了不少珍貴的歷史建築，大家如前往參觀，宛如穿越時空，重返昔日鄉村歲月。嘉賓還推介於村內的蘆葦田打卡，是欣賞日落的夢幻好去處。

programme.title: 藍色管弦樂粵日
programme.desc: 升上高中的青野仍逃避小提琴與人群，卻接連得知天才佐伯直入讀海幕。重遇大提琴手山田後，他隨秋音等人參觀管弦樂團，竟被安排與佐伯即場合奏《四季．春》，久違的競爭心與過去亦再度被喚醒。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
programme.desc: 長沙灣一個樓盤，有新一期單位交樓，房門設計狹窄，露台外牆有瓷磚已剝落，為何如此？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵 及 航向未來粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 早前有虛擬保險公司通報系統遭駭客入侵，該公司客戶表示接到疑似詐騙電話，專家提供防範建議。慈正邨停車場後樓梯懷疑長期有人便溺，但管理處以未裝CCTV為由，聲稱無法追查？布偶貓妮妮被充當獸醫的護士誤切膀胱一事，報道播出後引關注。貓主先後向獸醫管理局、警方報告事件，卻未有負責人被起訴。此外，涉事動物診所的前獸醫受訪，揭露診所更多內幕……施政報告提出試行「外籍家居照顧員計劃」，究竟照顧員與外傭有何分別？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#76粵
programme.desc: 嘉驄被迫創作黑化圓妃的漫畫故事，陳公子更派編輯貼身催稿。嘉驄提出折衷方案，欲加入新角色替代圓妃「做壞事」，陳公子拒不接受更以巨額賠償逼嘉驄就範。編輯背着陳公子表示支持嘉聰的構思，獲嘉驄信任。唐芯到酒吧為嘉驄送銀包，編輯趁嘉驄離開向她遞上飲料，唐芯不虞有詐……翌日，圓圓及冠一發現嘉驄倒臥街頭，神智不清，送院後被驗出體內含有多種毒品。唐芯道出當晚發生的事，圓圓得知嘉驄慘況，決定親自替他解決問題……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#12粵PG
programme.desc: 素希仗着自己懷孕登堂入室，永康事後向菲雅保證其在何家的地位。無雙得悉菲雅遭人以影片威脅，內容竟直接指向菲雅有殺害子盈的動機與嫌疑。家俊從另一途徑獲得影片，脅逼菲雅就範。綺雲在寧養院撞見女子Cindy，暗下憂心，因其握有重大秘密。寶兒積極為選秀節目《天選之人》排練，與另一練習生Jennie起衝突，不甘公司偏袒對方。寶兒向德龍透露，想與父親相認……菲雅在基金會投票上出爾反爾，家俊憤然要公開影片……

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 距離弘大區僅十五分鐘車程，就可發掘到瀑布靚景？坐在咖啡廳露台、漫步水畔步道，以不同角度拍出網美級相片。雨天更添寒意，如風藉新鮮龍蝦盛宴補暖。珍寶龍蝦拼盤啖啖肉，即食拉麵亦獲龍蝦加持，如風大讚似皇帝般享受！踏足汝矣島公園，如風再次挑戰高空，登上熱氣球竟附送「過山車」體驗？漢江美景當前，如風不再是畏高的我！西班牙菜Omakase六百港元有找？如風一嚐「白湯匙」大廚融合分子料理的手藝，連碟底都要舐乾淨！

programme.title: 武則天#33粵普
programme.desc: 媚娘訓練李治論政，助他在朝堂一鳴驚人；世民則懷疑李牧假身分。徐慧告發李牧與媚娘舊情，李治亦與李牧正面衝突。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
騙中傳奇#18粵
programme.desc: 忠正找到四神像，和珅手下亦至，眾情急下帶走最輕的「順」神像，和珅手下取走其餘三神像。神像地下印有滿文，忠正將文字製成拓布，並將「順」神像收藏好即回京。嘉慶見拓文，娓娓道出當年雍正之手諭，指大清有一禍胎潛伏，真相在「順」神像內；和珅亦已同步知悉秘密。忠正與玉麟出發找尋「順」神像秘密，顧井竟遇上寶兒，寶兒套取忠正行蹤。玉麟終從「順」神像得到最後一篇滿文，秘密是乾隆竟是漢人，嘉慶要忠正等立即消滅神像。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 早前有虛擬保險公司通報系統遭駭客入侵，該公司客戶表示接到疑似詐騙電話，專家提供防範建議。慈正邨停車場後樓梯懷疑長期有人便溺，但管理處以未裝CCTV為由，聲稱無法追查？布偶貓妮妮被充當獸醫的護士誤切膀胱一事，報道播出後引關注。貓主先後向獸醫管理局、警方報告事件，卻未有負責人被起訴。此外，涉事動物診所的前獸醫受訪，揭露診所更多內幕……施政報告提出試行「外籍家居照顧員計劃」，究竟照顧員與外傭有何分別？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 多數更年期女士均會經歷潮熱，如嚴重還會影響日常生活，持續潮熱亦可增加患上心血管疾病的風險。治療方面，現時採用的非荷爾蒙藥物如何做到改善這症狀？留意婦產科醫生詳細解說。膽管炎有很多種類，成因、治療方法都不同。外科醫生提到，在香港最常見的病因是由膽石引起，膽石又是怎樣形成？醫生提醒患者不應因膽石體積小而忽略，而均衡飲食與適當運動均有助預防膽石及膽管炎。「睇餸食飯」，譚詠儀師傅示範「港味花螺」。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 第四回合，拍檔們要透過頭盤、主菜、甜品去講一個故事。黎諾懿、沈依紅把冰室美食「法式化」，黎總style的羅宋湯、炒牛河與西多士，令人期待！龔嘉欣、李家鋌則思考將飲宴佳餚呈現。嘉欣細心洗刷主打食材鮑魚，並得評判提醒訣要；加入芭樂、乳酪的楊枝甘露，幻化少女粉紅色彩。未評分，兩隊先自行檢討，有人帶漏材料，有人感慨甜品狀態不如理想！雖有不足，眾評判的評語讚賞不停，最終哪對拍檔取勝，率先出線？

programme.title: 大帥哥#10粵PG
programme.desc: 艾妞、天嬌送涼茶為軍人打氣，士氣立即飆升！細龜、佘南談判合作對付狄奇，可惜談不攏，反被狄奇作弄及恐嚇二人不可瓜分祿豐鎮。有軍人意外偷窺沅婉，馬炭反應過於激烈，沅婉從狄奇口中知道馬炭失控背後經歷。沅婉稱可為馬炭的指套保用一輩子，馬炭情不自禁擁抱她。馬炭悄悄送上一瓶狗尾草，沅婉誤以為是狄奇所送，甜在心頭，馬炭臉色一沉，狄奇則似有所悟。軍人訓練未如理想，軍費卻所剩無幾，狄奇經落蘆提醒後要求鎮中富商交稅。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#234粵
programme.desc: 朋與溢將事實告知眾人，悅表現出堅強的一面，支撐起大局。晚上朋卻發現悅只是在強裝鎮定，眾人開解將失業的溢，溢卻表示借此闖一番事業。朋終於接受手術，眾人紛紛到醫院陪伴，慶更在病床前告訴朋一個秘密。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 龍嘯青不悅白愁飛當上副樓主，狄飛驚從中挑撥；龍嘯青設局想拿下狄飛驚，卻被李念堂背叛，反被狄飛驚抓回六分半堂；小石來到關龍嘯青的牢獄，不料遇上朱小腰，救出龍嘯青後，朱小腰表明自己是金風細雨樓的弓箭手…

programme.title: Sunday好戲王粵PG
programme.desc: 龔嘉欣、何君誠、張美妮、喬寶寶互拼演技，釋放搞笑力量！四人中有一位另有「短跑好手」的身分，他們分別於「我係大話精」遊戲「示範」熱身、起跑及壓線動作，形態真假難分，「星級」評判陳松伶能否猜出誰是「飛毛腿」？今回「扮Friend食老虎」的「Friend底」名人，與松松有個共通點，到底一眾嘉賓可否令「扮Friend者」現形？深入民心的「騙子王」演員現身「另類好戲王」，分享出神入化的幕前「呃人」伎倆。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#235粵
programme.desc: 喜跟慶到雲南作義診，欲選出新一任高家「話事人」，竟讓義當選。義大灑金錢滿足眾人要求，花指義此舉將使高家陷入赤字，但義依然故我。朋要悅了解溢的工作情況，悅與義發現溢遭上司欺負，義為此聘請溢到藥房工作。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#6粵普PG
programme.desc: 小石帶著溫柔跟蹤傅宗書，要給他一個教訓，之後二人路經市集，聽到有人落水，小石立刻下水救人。落水的人是方應看，他得知溫柔的身分後，表明曾與她結下了姻親。溫柔對應看輕佻的態度很不屑，但應看卻對她很有興趣。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 購入波士頓龍蝦，連同多款配料及酥皮，焗出濃味的西湯「酥皮龍蝦湯」，平價煮出好滋味。另一道西式「蝦小菜」，是將煎過的琵琶蝦放入法國牛油軟包之中，味道媲美龍蝦！將蘿蔔絲水份釋出，加入麵粉、雞蛋及調味拌勻後炸，再灑櫻花蝦乾，便做出懷舊的「蘿蔔餅」。用猛火炸攋尿蝦是廚房常識，想做「避風塘攋尿蝦」還需甚麼調味料？用酥皮麵線捲着虎蝦烤成的「奇妙金絲蝦」，講求的技巧眾多，快快抄下重點！

programme.title: 航向未來粵
programme.desc: 運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 胸椎弧度一旦超過五十度便會界定為寒背，並可分為功能性與結構性兩類。脊醫除了細說兩者的不同成因外，更提到嚴重功能性寒背有可能威脅心肺健康。脊醫還以「先放鬆、後強化」為準則，示範相關運動。兩位女生早前參與世界技能大賽，分別於櫥窗設計及西點製作項目勇奪優異獎章，她們到來暢談賽前準備與比賽點滴。二人透露曾受賽場溫度影響，全靠臨場應變化解危機。「睇餸食飯」，廚藝專家傅季馨帶來「脆脆紫菜鯪魚餅」，香口惹味。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 張曦雯夥同梁偉灝，徐榮和譚詠儀組隊，從「拍檔聯乘」啟動對壘，徐榮演戲前原來曾是廚師！檢視兩隊餐單，評判幟哥認為菜式相對簡單？看到詠儀製作「話梅蓮藕烤麩」時，把烤麩上脆漿油炸，眾評判即有所期待。曦雯隊的頭盤「慢煮三文魚流心溫泉蛋」，控制溫度是關鍵！主菜方面，徐榮隊巧製「松葉蟹戒米飯」夠健康，他處理「炒飯」的刀法、拋鑊亦有板有眼。曦雯隊的煙燻白鴿胸利梳多飯，鴿胸經燻、煎、焗三重步驟，幟哥提到仍有缺點？

programme.title: 大帥哥#11粵PG
programme.desc: 狄奇為籌措軍費徵收人頭稅，民怨沸騰！此時少帥突然失蹤，狄奇心知是誰搞鬼，接納沅婉建議退稅。狄奇一計不成，決定舉辦盆菜宴，向鎮民痛陳利弊，游說軍隊攻打祿豐鎮……細龜、佘南互相不肯撤離祿豐鎮，英俊提供一個雙贏的方法。馬炭、羅義討論攻鎮策略，被落蘆批評得體無完膚，聲稱只有一個方法才能成功。出戰前夕，沅婉要求加入大軍任軍醫，狄奇斷然拒絕，安排三女各司其職。大軍出發前，狄奇發現三女喬裝潛入軍隊……

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 英叔生日將至，花輪同學詢問小丸子意見，最後決定大家一起為英叔慶生，給他一個驚喜。小丸子是龜族的一份子，為了不再讓其他動物小看龜族，小丸子等龜族毅然求教龜爺爺，並向兔族作出挑戰。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，這集兩節訓練需要用上不同工具，集齊小健身球及兩個水樽，就可開始做熱身。保持V-Sit姿勢或躺下後抬起腳，再推移健身球，有助強化核心肌力。接下來的動作更具挑戰，雙手雙腳踏實在地，抬起臀部前後移動的同時，也不能讓放於腹部的健身球掉下來！第二輪要大家在指定距離之間完成鍛練，並以水樽作標示。向左右跳步、抬腳伸向不同方向等動作都只靠單腳支撐，好好訓練平衡力與穩定度。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 又來到一年一度的校舍清潔比賽。朱莉亞與詠瑠雖為室友，卻礙於性格迴異，經常吵架。於是，她倆便乘着這個機會，在比賽中盡情較量。另一方面，陽葵與美月作為兩支隊伍的隊長，竟將對決丟到一旁，和睦地一起打掃。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 現代社會人浮於事，年輕人想找工作絕對不易，政府和社福機構都為年輕人舉行培訓，甚至幫他們找僱主試工，成效有多大？新聞掏寶和大家重溫1999年專題。

programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#77粵
programme.desc: 朱基因龔喜一句話，不惜潛入外國博物館盜取寶物，成了國際通輯犯；龔喜卻習以為常，毫不擔心。龔喜得悉前男友Steven來港註冊結婚，遂與嘉冰前往搞破壞。嘉冰等人因此得知龔喜曾遭他陷害入獄，朱基不惜身陷囹圄相救。Steven趁朱基出埠處理盜寶風波，派人綁架龔喜與嘉冰，勢要與龔喜一刀兩斷，並道出當年分手及龔喜入獄的真相。朱基趕至救人，揭穿「真相的另一面」；混亂間，Steven向朱基擲飛刀，龔喜飛撲擋刀……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#13粵PG
programme.desc: 無雙與菲雅達成協議，聯手調查行跡可疑的綺雲。無雙向雲生提出合資建設串流平台與實體影城，並以競選電影總會主席為條件。雲生命鳳儀蒐集現任主席黑材料逼其退選，綺雲深感地位危機，二女針鋒相對。菲雅順利親近綺雲，無雙付酬讓素希中止任務，沒料素希另有想法。鳳儀以生日會爭奪雲生身旁的女主人地位，並刻意支開綺雲……德龍為阻止寶兒與父親相認，竟在鳳儀的生日會上鬧事。綺雲終返港，卻沒有前往生日會……

programme.desc: 節目組預備了三段百萬級點擊影片，讓如風猜數字及排序。愛好醬油蟹的如風輕易吃掉桌上四隻蟹，得知食店採放題制，即刻要追加！她聽到價錢，更加嘩一聲！商場內有個動物園，如風嘗試接近園內多類動物，甚至準備餵食，但她似乎沒甚麼「動物緣」。環境甚普通的連鎖炸雞店，卻被網民封為韓國三大炸雞店？如風嚐過招牌「薯仔炸雞」後，大為改觀，連幕後人員都幾乎忘記還有另一款炸雞要介紹！這集還有如風私心推介的「稀有包包收藏庫」。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#235粵

programme.desc: 無雙疑惑綺雲不惜缺席生日會的原因，此時寶兒竟被爆料是雲生的私生女。其後，雲生偕寶兒召開記招……寶兒怪責德龍知而不告，德龍自責。無雙關心寶兒的同時，也對雲生之舉存疑，擔心寶兒無法遠離紛爭。丁丁查到線索，無雙藉電影《玫瑰》勘景之便，潛入療養院找到Cindy的母親，並破壞綺雲的跟蹤行動。無雙最終聯同菲雅順利與Cindy見面，菲雅意外知悉父親之死並不單純，於是拉着Cindy要前往警署報警，詎料……

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 一日玩足首爾十個景點？如風跟「鴨仔團」實測。從桂洞街往北村三景、韓屋村，沿途佈滿韓屋建築，如風瘋狂上斜縱感辛苦，仍樂於影靚相。經水泥風咖啡廳步至三清洞壁畫村，竟見激似C君的畫像？來到仁寺洞手作市集，如風搜獲戰利品，再試米田共造型冬甩。求籤扭蛋機夠特色，如風心急測戀愛運，竟砸中手指！一睹景福宮交接儀式後，往廣藏市場覓食，為蒜蓉包排隊半小時也值得？如風行到腳痛，其中昌德宮、東大門行程只得「到此一遊」。

programme.title: 武則天#35粵普
programme.desc: 蕭薔縱火欲與媚娘、徐慧同歸於盡，徐慧捨身救媚娘而獲封賢妃。楊長史則挑起李牧仇恨，宮廷再醞釀逼宮危機。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
騙中傳奇#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)太和殿內，玉麟搬出另一真「順」神像，忠正出現，百般侮辱玉麟，玉麟無奈將牙人身份退讓。忠正謂真神像真金不怕烘爐火，但神像竟被燒毀，和珅才知被忠正出賣。假神像內之滿文透露大清禍胎乃是和珅，嘉慶將和珅斬首。原來當天寶兒獻身給和珅，取得玉麟的解藥，免忠正被威脅。寶兒決定重新做人，而顧井亦發覺自己愛上了九斤二。玉麟誕下雙胞胎，九斤二亦答允下嫁顧井。嘉慶賜封忠正「天下第一牙」，讓他們永享福祿。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 牙周病為何無法根治？牙醫指此症因清潔不當讓牙菌膜積聚所致，如嚴重會令牙肉與牙骨流失，並無法自然回復狀態。牙醫強調，牙周病或會影響身體其他地方的血管、增加認知障礙風險等。除了治療資訊，牙醫亦細說相關徵兆及預防方法。掌中木偶是非遺項目之一，有學校將它與中國歷史融合並向學生推廣。副校長概述木偶的製作過程，同來的學生分享學習過程苦與樂，還即席示範簡單的木偶動作。「睇餸食飯」，Annie奉上「話梅花雕蝦」。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 徐榮與曦雯在「五分鐘速煮」，分別帶來薑蔥魚雲、芝士煙肉燒生蠔，呈現中、西滋味。徐榮的家常魚菜式獲不俗評價，唯獨下調味料時有小失誤；曦雯的出品卻令幟哥不敢品嚐？詠儀、偉灝各自奉上的「上湯龍蝦伊麵」與「西班牙紅蝦燴象拔蚌北海道海膽」皆主打鮮味。偉灝炒蝦殼期間香氣四溢，引得幟哥、「顧老闆」上前觀看。詠儀煮伊麵時獲幟哥指點可善用龍蝦湯，隨即「聽話」重做。這趟「廚師主理」強強對壘，會為比賽形勢帶來甚麼變化？

programme.title: 大帥哥#12粵PG
programme.desc: 狄奇以軍法處罰沅婉三女，處罰對象令她們放棄隨軍。大軍出發後，三女遇到不祥預兆。狄奇、馬炭各自領軍突襲祿豐鎮，遇到伏擊。落蘆認定馬炭是少爺，堅持陪伴而受重傷。馬炭想起落蘆說過的軍事常識，成功製造爆炸；羅義中彈受傷，還看見三女來到，狄奇決定兵行險着……狄奇謊稱落蘆已死，引冬來說出真話。羅義緊張尋找丟失的軍帽，艾妞拾得軍帽，發現……馬炭建議狄奇趁機擴大版圖，狄奇訴說想法。英俊發帖邀請狄奇進餐……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#236粵
programme.desc: 義揭發情的「新男友」是德安，上前興師問罪。情道出安經已與父親反目，義不相信。義拉情回家，朋當眾宣布獲外國電視台聘請，當烹飪節目主持。言罷更向眾人表示將高家「話事人」的責任交予義，令義不敢說出情的事來。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#7粵普PG
programme.desc: 小石帶關七去找鶴發，怎料關七把鶴發的妻兒殺光，小石勸阻不果，懊悔不已。關七把想救人的小石綁住，夢枕和愁飛知道關七不好對付，便出計策讓雷損協助救人。關七在小石身上綁上炸藥並把他關在棺材裡，拖到宗書府中…

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 滕麗名、吳家樂、江欣燕、胡諾言替四位老友記拍攝沙龍，實現他們尚未完成的心願。阿滕和欣欣還親自為老友記化妝，還原他們的年輕美貌。鄂永城與太太劉寶添結婚數十載，一直自責欠老伴一個浪漫的求婚，適逢鑽婚紀念，他決定為愛妻補回甜蜜回憶。李煥紅重拾青春，只為拍攝一輯高貴大方的寫真，家樂與她前往設計髮型，完成造型一刻令她充滿驚喜。羅惠自小勤奮好學，主持帶她到訪舊式影樓，製作一張張夢寐以求的學生畢業照。

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 滕麗名、吳家樂、江欣燕、胡諾言到訪「香港流浪狗之家」做義工，照顧廬內的328位「汪星人」。四位義氣仔女同是愛狗之人，打掃狗廬、替狗剪毛、洗澡當然義不容辭，可是也不時弄出「蝦碌」場面！狗兒愛跑愛跳，主持帶牠們乘坐狗巴士往野外舒展筋骨，以一次小型旅行建立可貴的人狗之情。三百多頭大、小狗兒同時開飯要隆重其事，狗廬每餐要準備多少狗糧侍候？欣欣、胡仔還嘗試替小狗餵藥，並帶牠們到動物診所看醫生。

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 漢摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.title: 漢摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 夫婦的世界

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 漢摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.title: 漢摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.desc: Vicente Rangel, a musician turned detective, embarks on a police case to catch a murderer of girls in a corrupt oil town on the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: Murders in Pont-Aven
programme.desc: The bodies of two gallery owners are found. These murders are reminiscent of the death of Suzanne, a painter, 20 years ago. The investigation is led by Marion, Suzanne's daughter, and by Antoine who was in charge of the investigations at the time.

programme.title: The Apple of My Eye
programme.desc: Elise is beautiful, funny, and blind. Theo is a seducer but a loser. They love music. But when they meet in the elevator, it's hate at first sight.

programme.title: A Thousand Times Good Night
programme.desc: Rebecca is one of the world's top war photographers. She must weather a major emotional storm when her husband and young daughters refuse to put up with her dangerous life any longer. They need Rebecca, who, however, loves both her family and her work.

programme.title: SAF
programme.desc: Desperate, Kamil takes a low wage job in Istanbul's urbanization project. In so doing, he displaces a Syrian refugee and partakes in his neighborhood’s destruction, while also needing to pay for the required permits. One day, Kamil suddenly disappears.

programme.title: All The Songs We Never Sang

programme.title: Murders in Porquerolles

programme.desc: Life is busy these days and what with work and our hectic social lives, lots of us are on the go all the time. No fry muffin frittatas packed with fresh veg and ingenious chicken noodle pots with spiralized veg make a healthy lunch even eaten at your desk. And the girls' signature paradise bar is a sweet treat to get you through the afternoon.

programme.title: Donal Skehan: Home Cook S01 - EP7
programme.desc: Donal is making dishes fit for entertaining - a baked cheesecake crowned with cherries and crispy garlic chicken legs.

programme.title: Amanda and Alan's Spanish Job S01 - EP1
programme.desc: Amanda Holden and Alan Carr take on their biggest and most ambitious project yet as they embark on transforming a run-down Andalusian townhouse into a boutique B&amp;B.

programme.title: Amanda and Alan's Spanish Job S01 - EP2
programme.desc: Amanda and Alan tackle their first task, designing a Spanish dining room and foyer. Alan's dreams of a lavish reception area come crashing down, as he's confined to under the stairs.

programme.title: Jason Atherton's Dubai Dishes S01 - Vegetables
programme.desc: Jason shares his love of fresh produce with a trip to a supersized Dubai vegetable market as he makes dishes that include a tomato tartare with black olive tapenade and a pudding made with beetroot and carrot. He is joined by Chef Mohamed Orfali, who visits a farm just outside Dubai that grows vegetables in desert sand.

programme.title: Jamie's Money Saving Meals S01 - EP1
programme.desc: Jamie elevates bargain veggies in an Indian-inspired dosa, makes a DIY crispy breadcrumbed chicken takeaway, creates an oozy barley risotto and finishes off with thrifty choc-orange shortbreads.

programme.title: Amazing Hotels: Life Beyond the Lobby S05 - Borgo Egnazia, Italy
programme.desc: Monica Galetti and Rob Rinder visit Italy to go behind the scenes of Borgo Egnazia - a hotel modelled on Puglia's historical local villages. They work with the local staff to find out how you deliver a genuine version of Italy within a carefully designed replica. Monica makes focaccia for the cherry festival with chef Rocco, while Rob meets the decoration team who work hard to deliver an experience that blends reality with theatre.

programme.title: Hemsley + Hemsley - Healthy and Delicious S01 - On the Go
programme.desc: Life is busy these days and what with work and our hectic social lives, lots of us are on the go all the time. The Hemsley sisters help us not to fall for quick fix fast food with healthy and clever nutrient rich recipes that are also perfectly portable. No fry muffin frittatas packed with fresh veg and ingenious chicken noodle pots with spiralized veg make a healthy lunch even eaten at your desk. And the girls' signature paradise bar is a sweet treat to get you through the afternoon.

programme.title: Jamie: Eat Yourself Healthy S01 - EP3
programme.desc: Jamie makes a super-easy and nutritious seared tuna with tangy kimchi sauce, celebrates fibre-packed overnight oats, and cooks up a nourishingly hearty chicken and mushroom hotpot.

programme.title: The World's Most Secret Hotels S01 - Hidden Retreats
programme.desc: In British Columbia we delve deep into the Chilcotin Wilderness - an area so remote, only one thousand residents live in its 32 million acre landscape. In Iceland, we uncover The Glass Cottage, an unusual and very small black building covered in reflective glass and surrounded by lava fields.

programme.title: Amazing Hotels: Life Beyond the Lobby S05 - Glenapp Castle, Scotland
programme.desc: In Scotland, Monica Galetti and Rob Rinder discover Glenapp Castle, where guests are treated to a magical stay made possible by a dedicated team of local staff. Monica and Rob are put to work collecting home-grown veg for the kitchens and giving eagle demonstrations in the castle grounds, before joining forces to deliver an intrepid sea safari and a glamping trip to the Hebridean Isle of Jura.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off S17 - Audience Choice Week
programme.desc: In a Bake Off first, the viewers are in charge! The bakers face a mystery box and unleash their inner fashionistas with wearable bakes. But whose faux pas sees them saying au revoir?

programme.title: The Graham Norton Show S34 - EP9
programme.desc: Graham Norton introduces another instalment of his trademark mix of cheeky celebrity chat and live music performances.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Food Stars: Australia S01 - EP4
programme.desc: Gordon and Janine's rival teams must deliver the ultimate foodie event for 20 reviewers. To win, they must secure top reviews on their atmosphere, entertainment, and menu. The losing team is grilled, and a Food Star is sent home.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Grandparents Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are tidying up - its Bring your Grandparents to Squirrel Club Day. Duggee has his Grandparents badge so he knows what they will like, a nice cup of tea. But on arrival, these Grandparents seem more of a lively bunch than Duggee was expecting! Tag's Gran parachutes in from a plane and Norrie's Gran is a biker and arrives on her motorbike! Once in the clubhouse they launch into Show & Tell. These Grandparents have some GREAT stories to share!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Wedding Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are playing at the clubhouse when there is a knock at the door. Its delivery Chipmunk with a special delivery for Duggee and the squirrels. Duggee opens the envelope and takes out the card inside: It is with very great pleasure that I invite Duggee and the Squirrels to my Wedding... WOW, King Tiger has met his perfect partner and he is getting married. It's going to be a royal wedding!! The squirrels are to be special Guests of Honour, but who is King Tiger marrying!? programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Flying Party
programme.desc: Maisy flies her plane, and her friends join for a party in the sky.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Mermaid
programme.desc: Sing along with Maisy Mermaid!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Banana
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Banana revealing yet another astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, "I've Got a Secret"

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Cabbage
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the marvelous Cabbage and his dazzling super-veggie memory skills.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Tablet Takeover
programme.desc: The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they've found. When they're not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Carrot's Big Top
programme.desc: Carrot is starring in a circus, but problems arise when Evil Pea meddles with her tricks.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Picnic
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go on a very special picnic together. Lots of Tubby Toast pops out of the Dup Dup and lands on the picnic plates for the Teletubbies to munch.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Tractor
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'tractor' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see all sorts of tractors - a blue tractor, a pulling tractor, a stuck in the mud tractor and an on a farm tractor.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Mr Kite Takes Flight
programme.desc: As Messy monster is about to take a bite out of his delicious green sock, it gets blown away!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Ice Cream Float
programme.desc: Betty's new ice cream flavour is so light, it makes everybody in town float in the air. How will Mojo and Bo get everyone's feet back on the ground? By floating up there with them!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Mud Volcano, Azerbaijan
programme.desc: Glitch's plan to use methane gas from a mud volcano to power Lars's new machine has explosive results! Can the bickering pair stop a huge fire and save the Grimbots?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Neighbours
programme.desc: Bluey needs her Mum's advice on dealing with a troublesome neighbour, when the serenity of her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's own growing stable of animals.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Charades
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy, the T Rex and the Volcano
programme.desc: When the ground begins to shake on Dino Island, Jen and Andy suspect the volcano is to blame. Along the way, Andy meets not one, but two T-rex's.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Bees
programme.desc: Bella gives Lift a spring clean with her fuzzy, buzzy bee duster! Together they visit Sketch in Boxtropolis. What will she make today?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Sleeping Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have had an exhausting morning playing. After their milk they can have their nap. Lovely...but Tag can't sleep! Don't worry, Duggee can help, he has his Sleeping Badge and can offer a few tricks to get to sleep.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Island Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. What fun! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick Duggee suggests a stop off at the Island for a spot of lunch, but where's all the food?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Voice Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices it's clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - The Leshan Giant Buddha, China
programme.desc: The Go Jetters master the art of mindfulness to save the Giant Buddha of Leshan in China.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Max and Monty's antics on a construction site get them into trouble when they ignore the danger warning signs.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Too Loud, Thomas!
programme.desc: After Thomas loses his voice, he must find a new way to pass on a very important message.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Out of Site
programme.desc: Brenda learns that it is important to work as a team and not just care about her own jobs.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Waterspout Wipeout
programme.desc: Xuli, Lars and Glitch argue over whose vehicle is the best; the Vroomster, the Truckster or the Grimbler. Kyan suggests the only way to settle the argument is a race. A sudden waterspout helps Glitch take an early lead, but Ubercorn warns them about the much larger tornadic waterspouts that can sometimes appear. When the weather turns, Glitch and the Go Jetters find themselves in trouble. Can they get to safety before a huge tornado hits the island?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Floating Farms, Bangladesh
programme.desc: While clearing up the Academy farm after a heavy storm, the Go Jetters wish they could keep the plants above water. Glitch remembers a place where the farmers do just that - Bangladesh, where many farmers grow their crops on wooden platforms to avoid floods in the monsoon season. Glitch, Tala, Lars and Foz head to Bangladesh to see these floating farms, but after the Grimbots accidentally knock the Grimmer into a raft, Tala and a local farmer are swept into a nearby river! Glitch and the Go Jett

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Dream Team Trouble
programme.desc: After Glitch accidentally destroys part of the Academy, he and Ubercorn have a huge argument. When he heads to Grim HQ to make amends, Ubercorn is accidentally trapped as Glitch heads to the most remote place on earth: Point Nemo, in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. With the help of some friendly astronauts, Glitch and Ubercorn try to get a message to the Go Jetters before Grim HQ sinks to the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - 'X' Marks the Swop
programme.desc: An old map, mysterious clues and ancient secrets... Mojo and Bo are after the treasure of the Knights of Swoppiton! But Preston's after it too, so they need to get there first.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Cliffhanger
programme.desc: Felix the pig is stuck on a cliff ledge where not even Mojo's tops can reach him. They will need to be creative to get Bo up there and save that poor pig!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Trolley Cruise
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Broccoli get free tickets to go on a luxurious trolley cruise, but it's actually a one-way ticket out of the supermarket from Evil Pea!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - The Evil Peamobile
programme.desc: Evil Pea builds her own Evil Peamobile - and it has more gadgets than the Tatocar! It's Carrot's job to make the Tatocar even better before the two cars to go head-to-head.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Runner Bean's Sporty Song
programme.desc: Get ready, set, dance in the supermarket aisles with Supertato, Runner Bean and the whole Tato Team! Featuring Nitro from Gladiators.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Carrot Power Song
programme.desc: Dance along with Carrot, the Tato Team's super cool, brave inventor. This song celebrates all things Carrot power!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Radio Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels stumble upon some of Duggee's old radio equipment and decide to start their own show.

programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the war's front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two clash in a duel. Miao Lung wrests the medallions, but cannot avert history's tragedy.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Undercover police officer Shan is sent to prison to befriend crime boss Tin and gather evidence. After Tin’s release, Shan helps him rise through the ranks by eliminating rivals. But when his contact with police arouses suspicion, Shan’s cover is exposed, leaving him in a deadly predicament as a secret that could change everything emerges.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his father's death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late father's friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

Even worse;the playgroup’s other new member is Mega Fat;whose animatronic stuffie Wagby malfunctions and threatens the safety of the whole group. Meanwhile;Tim does everything he can to avoid doing his homework.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga (The Babblist)
programme.desc: There’s a new “babblist” in town- someone who claims to understand baby talk. Boss Baby spots this fraud right away;and must debunk his tactics before he scams the playgroup parents. Meanwhile;Tim tries to sell magazines with Boss Baby’s help.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - The Big Break
programme.desc: Boss thought that breaking his arm was painful;but the true pain starts at pediatrician Dr. Kevin’s “jokes.” Boss enlists the playgroup babies to defang the doctor of his “comedian’s disease.” Tim obsesses about keeping his little brother safe.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Puppy Party!
programme.desc: Boss comes face to face with his old nemesis;Bug The Pug;after the playgroup parents decide to throw a Puppy Party. Staci creates a “No-Paperworkist” movement to avoid Buddy From HR’s constant paperwork.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Stink of Fear: Chapter Two
programme.desc: While Boris and Natasha continue their mission and Bullwinkle tries to overcome his stage-fright to advance in the cooking competition, a secret government agency begins tracking Rocky &amp; Bullwinkle's movement

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - King Me
programme.desc: Uncle King Julien abdicates his throne, handing off his crown to Prince Julien. Let the reign of King Julien the Thirteenth begin.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Poll Position
programme.desc: King Julien learns that 99% of the lemurs love him, so he makes it his mission to find and convert his one "hater."

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Booving In Sant Oh
programme.desc: Best friends Tip and Oh drive each other crazy when he moves into the human world with her.Oh stirs up trouble when he tries to act like Santa Claus.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Little Kisses Snow Day
programme.desc: Tip busts Oh eating kitty litter and says he'll never get kissed by My Mom again.Oh and Tip help out all his friends when they freeze into Boovsicles.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Cause for The Paws
programme.desc: Po, at the top of his game but lonely, comes across two weasels stealing an earthquake causing gauntlet and tries to stop them, but inadvertently destroys a town. He loses his title as Dragon Master and teams up with Wandering Blade, a knight on a mission from England, to track down the weasels and get his title back.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight’s Code
programme.desc: Po and Blade's personalities clash as they track Klaus and Veruca and fight off some of Po's old foes. Blade gets to see Po's kung fu mastery, but doesn't agree to team up with him until she realizes that he accidentally holds the key to finding Klaus and Veruca: he has a piece of the WuGao Gauntlet. Meanwhile, Klaus and Veruca continue on their path of destruction while looking for the mysterious "Lotus".

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lotus
programme.desc: Po's moral lines are blurred when he and Blade have to break an untrustworthy hedgehog monk (Zhen) out of jail to get more information on what Klaus and Veruca stole from the Lotus. They learn from Zhen that there are in fact three more weapons, and Po recognizes one of them from a comic book.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Phil Pickle
programme.desc: When Phil's beloved stick companion Philliam goes missing, he enlists the help of Ugga and Eep who lead an investigation across the farm.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Best Friend in Show
programme.desc: Each kid believes that they have the best pet on the farm, and hold a contest to prove it. Meanwhile, Phil's attempts to find a pet to enter proves dangerous, as he turns to wild animals.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Game Of Crows
programme.desc: The Croods and Bettermans take in Malachi, Gran's longtime enemy, until his broken wing heals. Eep is unsure whether or not Malachi can be trusted.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Take Over
programme.desc: The team manages to infiltrate Sudarikov’s base and learn that he’s building a fleet of AI cars equipped with Tony’s driving ability! When the AI cars come to life, our gang’s mission changes from trying to shut down the cars to just trying to survive.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Toretto Virus
programme.desc: The team has shut down Sudarikov’s base and are ready to celebrate…unitil the base starts moving on its own. The Toretto AI takes control of the base and begins its mission to take over the world starting with infecting nearby Bangkok. Tony realizes that the only way to stop the virus is to engage in the ultimate battle: Toretto vs. Toretto.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Incineration Day
programme.desc: The Spy Racers learn from Ms. Nowhere about Incineration Day, an agency “holiday” where spy tech is destroyed in a fun, safe, stress-relieving explosion. But when a mysterious figure steals the warehouse full of to be destroyed spy tech, the team heads to Europe to embark on their most dangerous mission yet.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Eye Of The Beholder Pt 1
programme.desc: Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders discover a mysterious object filled with secrets during their search for Dagur the Deranged.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Eye Of The Beholder Pt 2
programme.desc: Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders journey to Glacier Island in search of the Snow Wraith, a fearsome dragon that holds key to the Dragon Eye's mysteries.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Imperfect Harmony
programme.desc: The Dragon Riders discover a lush island that turns out to be the home of the Deathsong, a massive dragon that threatens to trap them forever.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - CJ WooferbugWhat Did I Miss
programme.desc: DJ is excited to give her niece CJ her own wooferbug for her birthday. But the wooferbug proves difficult to transport across Trolls Village. Will DJ be able to get it to CJ before CJ’s birthday party ends?When Peppy takes an entire day to get a new haircut, he asks Poppy to fill him in on what he missed. What follows is a series of short sketches, as we explore an average day in Troll Village.

programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth stet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The stet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their sarate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains.

programme.title: The Last Breakthrough - EP8
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins "Life Force", an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up "Lung Shing Medical Centre" to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named "Ling Siu" in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins "Lung Shing" later.
